title: The Basin Unmaking Canon
summary: The school canon of filling the qi field like a basin and letting the unmaking spill over its brim onto the chosen ground.

title: The Dual-Track Ruin Crown
summary: The school's high course of two tracks of ruin from the core that meet at the crown in a single breaking blow.

title: The Gale-Sworn Razing Canon
summary: The school canon of razing sworn to the wind that levels the works of the foe and spares the sworn.

title: The Oath Beneath the Broken Wind
summary: The school's deepest oath sworn to a wind that has broken and loosed from the core as a ruin nothing can mend.
